summary: GALLERI EKG AS (org. no. 912 596 729) is a private limited company (AS) based in Hamar, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2013-10-17. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 47.690 (Detaljhandel med kulturvarer ikke nevnt annet sted); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2024 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 743 439 and net income was -NOK 298 311. CEO: Pirjo Birgitta Mursu; board chair: Pirjo Birgitta Mursu.
